gloss: rate of progress; pace of advancement

definitions.gloss: rate of progress; pace of advancement; degree of progress
definitions.explanation: The speed or degree to which work, study, or a project has advanced. Commonly used in educational and business contexts to measure how far along something is.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}の{進度|しんど}が{速|はや}い。
examples.english: The pace of the class is fast.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}の{進度|しんど}を{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the progress of the construction.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}によって{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{進度|しんど}が{違|ちが}うので、{転校|てんこう}すると{戸惑|とまど}うことがある。
examples.english: Since the pace of the textbook differs between schools, transferring can be confusing.

notes:
Compound of {進|しん} (advance) and {度|ど} (degree). Focuses on the rate or extent of advancement, particularly in structured contexts like education, construction, or project management.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進度|しんど}が{速|はや}い: the progress is fast
- {進度|しんど}が{遅|おそ}い: the progress is slow
- {進度|しんど}を{合|あ}わせる: to match the pace
- {進度|しんど}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the progress
- {学習|がくしゅう}{進度|しんど}: learning progress/pace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進捗|しんちょく}: progress — more formal, used in business for project status updates
- {進行|しんこう}: progression, advance — the act of moving forward, broader usage
- ペース: pace — loanword used casually for speed of progress
